account.balance_role: asset for checking and savings, liability otherwise

fixture_defaults.coverage: one row per account: coverage_status complete, basis_state confirmed, covered_from/covered_to = case period, unless the case has a coverage override

queries.spend: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(expense_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.net_spend: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(expense_minor),0)-COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN money_kind='refund' AND direction='inflow' THEN amount_minor END),0) FROM txn WHERE posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.income: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(income_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.net_sales: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(income_minor),0)-COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN money_kind='refund' AND direction='outflow' AND income_minor=0 THEN amount_minor END),0)+COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN money_kind='refund' AND direction='inflow' AND (lower(description) LIKE '%chargeback%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%dispute%') THEN amount_minor END),0) FROM txn WHERE posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.refunds_in: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE money_kind='refund' AND direction='inflow' AND posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.card_paid: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE money_kind='card_payment' AND posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.loan_paid: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE money_kind='loan_payment' AND posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.borrowed: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE money_kind='loan_proceeds' AND direction='inflow' AND posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
queries.interest: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(expense_minor),0) FROM txn WHERE lower(description) LIKE '%interest%' AND posted_on BETWEEN :from AND :to
